test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

Rekha was very fascinated by the solitude offered by the hillside.

options.text: The solitude offered by the hillside fascinated Rekha very much.
The solitude offered by the hillside was fascinating Rekha very much.
The solitude was offering Rekha the hillside fascination very much.
The solitude was offered by the hillside fascinating Rekha very much.

solution:
The correct answer is **"The solitude offered by the hillside fascinated Rekha very much."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. It is in Simple Past Tense.
 
• As per the given question, we must change it to Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• In the passive voice, the action **"offering"** is performed by the doer** "Rekha."**
 
• "The solitude" is the subject and **"Rekha"** is the object in the active voice.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *The solitude offered by the hillside fascinated Rekha very much.*
